title: rasgo.deploy.yml, version 1
description: Deploy contract at the root of each repository: what it is, how it deploys and how a deploy is checked. Names and references only: no hosts, paths with secrets or values.

component.description: Name in the Registry of RASGO Core: the repository, or the site it publishes.

adapter.description: Reusable workflow that runs the deploy.

migrations.description: Command the deploy runs after the code, or none. The record of the deploy in Core shows it.

path.description: Path on the environment url that answers with the deployed version (for example /version).

expect.description: version: the answer contains the deployed ref; status: only the HTTP status.

rollback.description: previous-tag: deploy again the tag before; none: no rollback by the system.

ref.description: What deploys: a branch name, or tag for the published release.

approval.description: merge: deploys with Sergio's merge or run, which Core checks in deploy-start (D-111). none: automatic (level 2), staging only. core: the name of merge before D-111, read as merge until rasgo-wp-base and the sites made from it change their contract.

secrets.description: Names of the environment secrets the adapter reads (for example the Ploi deploy webhook). Never values.

allOf.description: Production always deploys with Sergio's merge (D-111).
